title: 第10章
content_zh: 至尊狂妻“爷爷，以前是雪儿不懂事，不理解哥哥的苦心，现在雪儿已然清醒了，怎么还会怪哥哥呢！”冷若雪有些感动地道，那傻若雪虽然痴傻，可是却有如此疼爱她的家人，这大概就是傻人有傻福吧！她也算是沾了傻若雪的光，得到了自己一直渴望着的亲情，所以她一定会好好珍惜。“爷爷，雪儿有些事都不记得了，你和雪儿说说哥哥的事吧！”冷若雪撒骄地道。“好，好。”“雪儿啊，你哥哥可是天才排行榜上排名第二位的天才啊，是我们冷家的骄傲，他现在正在‘凤天学院’学习呢，是‘凤天学院’院长唯一的关门弟子，就刚刚那老家伙，就是你哥哥的师傅。”冷擎天简明扼要的说道。难怪那老头不喜欢她，冷若雪忍不住在心中想到，自己的天才徒弟在家里的地位，却比不上一个傻子，这当师傅的不生气才怪。“天才排行榜？”冷若雪不解地看着自己的爷爷。“呃……就是咱们菱风大陆上天才的排行榜，凡是上榜的，都可以算得上是天才，不过只有50个名额，年龄还不能超过30岁。”冷擎天解释道。“哦。”冷若雪听到爷爷的解释，明白了，这排行榜和她想的有点不一样，居然是整个菱风大陆的排行榜，那上榜的50人岂不全都是难得一见的天才，她哥哥能在榜上排第二位，想必定是位惊才绝艳的绝世天才喽！“爷爷，那排第一位的是谁啊？”冷若雪有些好奇，居然有人比她哥哥还优秀？“是第一大世家，火家的天才少主火情。”“他的资质在哥哥之上吗？”“他和若寒的灵力亲和力都为超等以上，不过他比若寒多了一个灵力属性。”天才排行榜的评选标准，首先看灵力亲和力，其次是看灵力属性，若都一样，则算并列。“爷爷，明天我就去看哥哥。”冷若雪突然道，现在她对这个疼爱妹妹的天才哥哥，可是好奇的很。“好、好。”“那个……雪儿，还有件事？”冷擎天有些犹豫道。“什么事啊？爷爷！”冷若雪看到爷爷吞吞吐吐的，很是不解。冷擎天想了想，直接拿出圣旨递给雪儿，示意她自己看。冷若雪接过圣旨，满脸疑惑地打开。“夜辰？这又是谁？”冷擎天见宝贝孙女看完了圣旨上的内容，并没有他预想中的那么生气，不由得放下心来。“这夜辰是五大世家之一，夜家旁系的一个庶出的二少爷，天生体弱多病，他的嫡母是七皇子的姨母，芳贵妃的亲妹妹。”冷擎天解释着这其中错综复杂的关系。听完爷爷的解释冷若雪就明白了，原来又是和七皇子有关，这皇帝分明就是在打着她爷爷的主意，她怎么就摆脱不掉那阴魂不散的七皇子了呢？哼！最好别让她见到那个什么七皇子，否则有他好看的，冷若雪不禁在心中腹腓着。“爷爷，这圣旨他下他的，嫁不嫁可是由我说得算的！”冷若雪有些不屑地道，她对皇家可是没什么好感的，才不愿意和皇家扯上关系，虽说这个关系远了点，不过她要是装傻不嫁，想必皇帝也不能把她怎么样，谁让她是个‘傻子’呢！这个世界虽说是强者为尊，可是在没成为能够凌驾于皇权之上的强者之前，还是皇权至上的，所以她也不太想给爷爷惹麻烦，虽然她爷爷是灵皇巅峰强者，灵尊之下第一人，可是毕竟还不是灵尊级强者，在这个世界，只有成为灵尊级强者，才有资格与皇权平起平坐，可以不受皇权的约束，而只有成为灵神，才能够真正的凌驾于皇权之上，而这也是她的目标。“对，谁敢逼我的宝贝孙女做她不喜欢做的事，爷爷就和他拼命！”冷擎天宠溺地道，皇帝那道赐婚的圣旨，他根本就没放在心上，他只是怕宝贝孙女知道了生气而已，现在见雪儿也没当回事，他也就放心了。“雪儿，这个给你。”冷擎天递给雪儿一块金色的牌子。冷若雪有些狐疑地看着自己的爷爷，接过牌子，看了看，牌子正面只有两个字‘凤天’，背面则什么都没有。“现在你已经是‘凤天学院’的学生了，这牌子是你的身份证明，收好了，要是弄丢了，学院可是不让你进门的！”冷擎天嘱咐着。“爷爷，进‘凤天学院’都不用经过测试的吗？”冷若雪忍不住问道，据她所知‘凤天学院’可是菱风大陆三大学院之一，入学测试非常严格，能被‘凤天学院’录取的学生，即使不都是天才，至少也得是精英。“不用、不用，你爷爷我和那老家伙是多年的朋友，他又是若寒的师傅，这点面子他还能不给我？更何况我的宝贝孙女肯去他那学院学习，他可是应该感到荣幸的。”冷擎天一脸骄傲地道。冷若雪听到爷爷如此自恋的话，额头滑下几条黑线，不过，她要是想不被人发现她的天赋，还真是得走后门，想到这，她不禁为爷爷的细心而感动。翌日，她和爷爷打了声招呼，便带着绿桃前往‘凤天学院’。‘凤天学院’位于凤都最北部，由于路途较远，所以她们是坐着飞行灵兽‘隼’前去的，‘隼’是一种类似于鹰的低阶灵兽，虽然速度不是很快，可是性格温顺，又经过了训练，是菱天大陆上较为常用的代步工具之一，由于‘隼’面积较大，羽毛柔软，飞行时很平稳，所以很受到人们的喜爱。冷若雪躺在‘隼’的身上，一边看着沿途的风景，一边听绿桃讲她哥哥的事。“少爷真的很疼爱小姐，谁要是敢欺负小姐，少爷肯定不会放过那人，揍一顿都算轻的，上次七皇子差点没被少爷揍死。”“小姐受伤昏迷那几天，少爷每天都偷偷地来看小姐。”冷若雪听着绿桃说着她哥哥的事，对那个傻若雪真是既羡慕又嫉妒，不过既然现在这些亲人都是属于她的了，那么她就一定要守护好这得来不易的亲情。“小姐，到了，学院里是不让乘坐灵兽的，我们得走着进去。”绿桃解释道。“好。”两人从‘隼’上下来，朝着学院的门口走去，到门口的时候就被门卫给拦住了，冷若雪直接拿出那块牌子，就在门卫惊讶呆愣的目光中直接走进了学院。“这是哪个家族的大小姐啊，怎么会有那块牌子……难道她是水家大小姐？怪不得长得那么美……”良久之后，回过神来的门卫还在自言自语的道。冷若雪跟着绿桃直接来到她哥哥的住处，哥哥还在上课，宿舍里只有她哥哥的陪读鸣安在，冷若雪仔细打量着哥哥的住处，环境清幽，简单雅致，倒是有些像她哥哥的性格，虽然记忆中的哥哥样子有些模糊，不过仍能看得出哥哥那出尘的气质，实在很难想像这样的哥哥，居然会把人揍得半死。“雪儿。”一声轻唤打断了冷若雪的沉思。冷若雪转过头，看着门口处那如谪仙般出尘飘逸的绝美男子，这就是她的哥哥？比她记忆中更优秀的哥哥？漂亮的男人她见过不少，可是漂亮的如此干净，清透，如谪仙般不染纤尘的，她还是第一次见到，那比女子还要精致完美的五官，足以令任何一个女子为之羞愧，她甚至觉得，没有任何一个词能够形容出哥哥的美。就在冷若雪打量着自己哥哥的同时，冷若寒也同样在打量着她。这就是雪儿？清醒后的雪儿吗？和母亲好像，可是却比母亲更美，冷若寒看着自己的宝贝妹妹，虽然已经听爷爷说了，雪儿已经恢复了神智，他也有了心里准备，可是现在亲眼见到，内心仍然激动不已。“哥哥。”冷若雪有些紧张地轻轻叫道。
content_en: The Supreme Crazy Wife: "Grandpa, it was Xue'er who was ignorant and didn't understand her brother's hard work before. Now that Xue'er is awake, how can she still blame her brother?" Leng Ruoxue said with some emotion. Although Silly Ruoxue is stupid, she has a family who loves her so much. This is probably because stupid people are blessed! She has benefited from Silu Ruoxue and gained the family affection she has always longed for, so she will definitely cherish it. "Grandpa, Xue'er doesn't remember some things. Tell Xue'er about your brother!" Leng Ruoxue said arrogantly. "Okay, okay." "Xue'er, your brother is the second-ranked genius on the genius list. He is the pride of our Leng family. He is currently studying at Fengtian Academy. He is the only closed disciple of the dean of Fengtian Academy. The old guy just now is your brother's master." Leng Qingtian said concisely. No wonder the old man didn't like her. Leng Ruoxue couldn't help but think in her heart that her genius apprentice's status in the family was not as good as that of a fool. It was strange that the master was not angry. "Genius ranking list?" Leng Ruoxue looked at her grandfather in confusion. "Uh... it's the ranking list of geniuses on our Lingfeng Continent. Anyone on the list can be considered a genius, but there are only 50 places, and the age cannot be more than 30 years old." Leng Qingtian explained. "Oh." Leng Ruoxue heard her grandfather's explanation and understood that this ranking was a little different from what she thought. It was actually the ranking of the entire Lingfeng Continent. Then the 50 people on the list were all rare geniuses. If her brother ranked second on the list, he must be an amazing genius! "Grandpa, who is first in line?" Leng Ruoxue was a little curious, there was someone better than her brother? "He is Huo Qing, the genius young master of the Huo family, the largest aristocratic family." "Is his qualifications higher than those of his brother?" "Both his and Ruohan's spiritual affinity are super or above, but he has one more spiritual attribute than Ruohan." The selection criteria for the genius rankings are based on spiritual affinity first, and spiritual attribute secondly. If they are both the same, they are considered tied. "Grandpa, I'm going to see my brother tomorrow." Leng Ruoxue said suddenly. Now she was very curious about this genius brother who loved her sister. "Okay, okay." "Um...Xue'er, is there anything else?" Leng Qingtian said hesitantly. "What's the matter? Grandpa!" Leng Ruoxue was very puzzled when she saw her grandfather hesitating. Leng Qingtian thought for a while, then took out the imperial edict and handed it to Xue'er, gesturing for her to read it herself. Leng Ruoxue took the imperial edict and opened it with doubts on her face. "Ye Chen? Who is this?" Leng Qingtian felt relieved when he saw that his precious granddaughter was not as angry as he expected after reading the contents of the imperial edict. "This Yechen is one of the five great aristocratic families. He is a second young master from a concubine, a branch of the Ye family. He was born weak and sickly. His aunt is the seventh prince's aunt and the biological sister of Concubine Fang." Leng Qingtian explained the intricate relationship. After listening to her grandfather's explanation, Leng Ruoxue understood that it turned out to be related to the seventh prince. The emperor was clearly after her grandfather's ideas. Why couldn't she get rid of the lingering seventh prince? snort! It was best not to let her see that seventh prince, otherwise he would be good-looking, Leng Ruoxue couldn't help but feel anxious in her heart. "Grandpa, this imperial edict is his. I have the final say whether to marry or not!" Leng Ruoxue said with some disdain. She didn't have a good impression of the royal family, so she didn't want to be related to the royal family. Although the relationship was far away, if she pretended to be stupid and refused to marry, the emperor would not be able to do anything to her. Who made her a 'fool'! Although this world respects the strong, before becoming a strong person who can override the imperial power, the imperial power is still supreme, so she doesn't want to cause trouble to her grandfather. Although her grandfather is the peak powerhouse of the Spirit Emperor, the first person under the Spirit Emperor, but after all She is not yet a spiritual master. In this world, only by becoming a spiritual master can one be qualified to sit on an equal footing with the imperial power and be free from the constraints of the imperial power. Only by becoming a spiritual god can one truly be above the imperial power, and this is also her goal. "Yes, whoever dares to force my precious granddaughter to do something she doesn't like, grandpa will fight him to the death!" Leng Qingtian said dotingly. He didn't take the emperor's imperial edict of marriage to heart at all. He was just afraid that his precious granddaughter would be angry when she found out. Now that Xueer didn't take it seriously, he was relieved. "Xue'er, this is for you." Leng Qingtian handed Xue'er a golden sign. Leng Ruoxue looked at her grandfather with some suspicion, took the sign, and looked at it. There were only two words "Fengtian" on the front of the sign, but there was nothing on the back. "Now that you are a student of Fengtian College, this sign is your identification card. Keep it away. If you lose it, the college will not let you in!" Leng Qingtian ordered. "Grandpa, don't you need to pass a test to enter Fengtian Academy?" Leng Ruoxue couldn't help but ask. As far as she knew, Fengtian Academy was one of the three major colleges in Lingfeng Continent. The entrance test was very strict. Students who could be admitted to Fengtian Academy must be elites, if not all geniuses. "No, no, your grandfather and I have been friends with that old guy for many years, and he is Ruohan's master. How can he not give me this face? What's more, he should feel honored that my precious granddaughter is willing to go to his academy to study." Leng Qingtian said with pride. When Leng Ruoxue heard her grandfather's narcissistic words, a few black lines slid down her forehead. However, if she wanted to avoid being discovered by others, she really had to go through the back door. Thinking of this, she couldn't help but be touched by her grandfather's attentiveness. The next day, she said hello to her grandfather and took Lu Tao to Fengtian College. 'Fengtian Academy' is located in the northernmost part of Fengdu. Since it is a long way, they went there on the flying spiritual beast 'Falcon'.
